'''Rebel personnel carrier''' was a model of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] craft used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. This model of personnel carrier was open on all sides, able to seat two rows of personnel back to back. They transported passengers and cargo around various Alliance installations, and were occasionally used in combat.

During their occupation of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Alliance made use of the open-sided carriers to shuttle pilots and other personnel around the base.
